acceptance: Snapshot or golden tests of generator output from a fixed docs-data fixture run in site CI and fail on an unreviewed change; the TSBS render stability that the removed test covered is asserted in the exporter test.
description: docs:parity compares the TypeScript generators with the bundle's docs member, which schema 5 no longer carries, so it reports not applicable. The Python generators and the generator-vs-export test in tests/unit/scripts/test_export_docs_data.py are gone. Nothing now fails if a generator change alters the compat, query or tuning-matrix pages for the same docs-data.
